name: Taverity
description:
Taverity is an iPhone app that helps referral-driven professionals — real estate agents, loan officers, insurance brokers, and other relationship-based businesses — send personal follow-up texts from their own phone number to past clients and existing contacts.

This connector lets you set those messages up right inside Claude. Ask Claude to draft a one-off text or a small scheduled campaign to a single contact or a whole named list — e.g. "text my Past Clients list Happy Thanksgiving" or "schedule a check-in to my Buyers list for next Tuesday." Taverity queues it, and — this is the whole point — the message is sent from your own iPhone, over your own SIM and phone number, using Apple's native Messages. There is no Taverity phone number and no third-party SMS gateway in the loop.

Every message defaults to approval-first: it lands in the Taverity iOS app for you to review before it goes out, so nothing sends without you. You stay in control of the content and approve every send; Taverity handles the timing and delivery, not the relationship.

It's built for staying personally top-of-mind with people you already know — not cold outreach, bulk blasts, or replacing your CRM.

Requires the Taverity iPhone app. For teams of 10+, contact sales@taverity.com.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Taverity to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Taverity to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://portal.taverity.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Taverity MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Taverity provides these MCP tools: get_contact_lists, preview_one_time_message, and send_one_time_message.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Taverity?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Taverity in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Taverity requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Taverity is developed by Taverity Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
